story.fullStory:
Gorillaz's "Momentary Bliss" — original release 2026. "Momentary Bliss" is a song by British virtual band Gorillaz, featuring British rapper Slowthai and the Kent-based punk rock duo Slaves.

The song was the first song to be released for Gorillaz' Song Machine initiative, a web series consisting of singles and music videos released over the course of the year from the band, with each episode featuring different guest musicians.

The song was also the first single released for their seventh studio album, Song Machine, Season One: Strange Timez.

The discography of British virtual band Gorillaz consists of nine studio albums, three compilation albums, 11 extended plays, one remix album, and 51 singles.
